_what: Targeted horizon extensions for the redesigned Figure 3 (fig3_full_loop_ext). Written by analyze_fig3_full_loop.py when a cell fails the settled() drift test at its current horizon; copy the analyzer's fig3_extension_request.json here and commit so the cluster generator can emit the rows. Every entry re-runs the identical surface at 60 or 100 rounds under a pofdf3_ _r60/_r100 tag. gen_pofd_sweep.py validates each entry against the grid and refuses 60-round requests for cells whose reused artifact already has 60 rounds.
_convention: beta = W_PLAT, gamma = INNATE_LAMBDA (null where beta=1 dedups it), lam = the forward-KL coefficient; rounds in {60, 100}.

cells.reason: drift +0.0107 > 0.005 over rounds 21-30 of the reused pofdmem_ cell (verified locally 2026-08-24); the one cell of the completed 28 that fails the settled() test
